description: A union is a community of players. If you belong to a union, you can join in on union missions.
title: Union

description: You can join a union by searching for one or by creating a new one. Up to 10 players can join a union.
title: Union

description: Union missions are missions that all members take on together. Missions are reset each week on a specific day and time. Once you join a union, there is a minimum wait period before you can contribute to missions.
title: Union

description: Battle content for all union members to play is scheduled to come! Please wait for announcements coming soon!
title: Union

description: When you acquire a Kioku already in your possession, the additional copies will be used for ascension. Each ascension increases the Kioku's Special Attack Lvl.
title: Ascension

description: Duplicate copies of a Portrait can be consumed to perform ascension. Ascending a Portrait will improve the effects of the Portrait's skill.
title: Ascension

description: Rank will increase based on the number of Memsparks collected. There are benefits for each rank achieved, such as items, boosts to bonuses provided by Support Kioku, and unlocking of higher rank upgrade quests.
title: Puella Pictura Rank

description: In the Chamber of Light, you can view Puella Pictura and other collectibles (Gallery, Stories, Music) unlocked from obtaining Kioku and Memsparks.
title: The Chamber of Light

description: When viewing collectibles in the Chamber of Light for the first time you can earn Magica Stones.
title: Rewards for Viewing Chamber of Light Collectibles

description: "Steady Steps Forward: Magical Girl Dreams" is a permanent event. Limited-time events will also be released going forward. We hope you enjoy the upcoming event quests!
title: Event Quests

description: In event quests, you can take on battles a set number of times each day. Play a little each day to make your way through events.
title: Event Quests

description: In event quests, you can earn medals as battle rewards. Collect medals and trade them for Portraits and a variety of other items.
title: Event Quests

description: You can access the event trader from the banner on the top page of an event. Trade the medals you've collected for items such as Portraits and upgrade materials to help you progress through the game.
title: Event Quests

description: Victory is the goal as you battle against other players! You'll compete for rankings during the event period based on points earned. New seasons begin at set intervals.
title: Player Match

description: In Player Match, all battles proceed in Full Auto mode. Additionally, a break gauge is added for the Magical Girls in your party. The break gauge amount varies according to the Kioku's rarity and role.
title: Player Match

description: You can increase points earned from battles through different bonus conditions, such as defeating stronger opponents or having a win-streak. Aim to win by racking up points through these bonuses!
title: Player Match

description: You can earn rewards based on your ranking and points earned. Match Medals earned from point rewards can be exchanged for various rewards at the trader.
title: Player Match

description: You can play for free up to 5 times each day. You can also spend Magica Stones for additional plays. So be sure to play every day and shoot for grand rewards!
title: Player Match

description:
In these quests, you can earn materials to upgrade your Kioku.
Higher-difficulty quests yield higher-tier materials.
title: Upgrade Quests: Kioku Upgrade

description: In these quests, you can earn materials to upgrade your Kioku's Magic Lvl. Higher-difficulty quests yield higher-tier materials.
title: Upgrade Quests: Magic Unlock

description: The Tower is a limited-time event where you progress through Mirror Layers. Clear each layer to gain rewards, which get better the further you advance.
title: Tower

description: You'll start from Mirror Layer 1 for each event, allowing you to earn first-clear rewards again upon clearing. Boost the power of your Kioku to clear more layers next time around!
title: Witch Tower

description: Depending on your clear progress from last time, you can start ascending the Tower with certain mirror layers already cleared.
title: Quick Start

description:
Magical Girl Towers feature a variety of themes.
Your clear progress will carry over to the next event without being reset.
title: Magical Girl Tower

description:
Clearing certain Mirror Layers will unlock Extra Mirror Layers.
Extra Mirror Layers have an increased difficulty, so train your Kioku to make sure they're up to the challenge!
title: Magical Girl Tower

description: Raising the Lvl. of a Kioku will increase its stats. Kioku Lvl. can be raised by consuming special materials.
title: Kioku Lvl. Upgrade

description:
Each Kioku has a level cap.
It will increase further each time you raise your Player Lvl.
title: Kioku Lvl. Upgrade

description: This feature lets you enhance portraits. Raising their enhancement level will increase the effects of abilities.
title: Portrait Enhancement

description: You can get the materials you need for raising portrait enhancement levels from event and Player Match rewards.
title: Portrait Enhancement

description: Event missions also offer fabulous rewards for clearing high-difficulty quests.
title: Story Event

description: Story events will become locked once their initial availability period ends. All events, including those that are locked, can be replayed later. You can unlock them by using special items.
title: Story Event

description: You can now play quests that grant Magic Unlock materials. Clear battles to get the materials you need to upgrade the Magic Lvl. of your Kioku.
title: Magic Unlock Material Quest

description: You can earn more Magic Unlock materials by clearing higher rank quests. Quests of a certain rank or higher grant higher-grade Magic Unlock materials.
title: Magic Unlock Material Quest

description: You can increase your quest rank by raising your Puella Pictura to a certain rank.
title: Magic Unlock Material Quest

description: Raising a Magical Girl's Heartphial Lvl. grants a variety of bonuses, such as boosts to Kioku stats and access to Magical Girl Stories, unique Portraits, voice content, and more. Each magical girl has one Heartphial.
title: Heartphials

description: To raise Heartphial Lvl., you will need to use special materials. Materials can be obtained through Main Quests, Events, and other means.
title: Heartphials

description: Portraits obtained from Heartphials have useful abilities that activate when equipped to a Magical Girl's Kioku. So be sure to raise the Heartphial Lvl. to obtain portraits!
title: Heartphials

description: Score Attack is a feature where you defeat powerful enemies to earn scores based on the battle results. Depending on your score, you can earn high score and total score rewards.
title: Score Attack

description: High score rewards are obtained based on the maximum score you earn during the Score Attack event. The higher the difficulty, the higher the score you can earn, and fulfilling certain conditions like clearing a battle quickly or minimizing damage taken will grant you an even higher score.
title: Score Attack

description: Total score rewards are obtained based on the total value of scores earned during the Score Attack event. You don't need to earn a high score in a single battle, so you can clear battles repeatedly to boost your total.
title: Score Attack

description: Clear Heartphial quest battles to earn Heartphial EXP for the Magical Girls assigned as Main Kioku to your party. So form a team with the Magical Girls you want to earn EXP with and take them into battle!
title: Heartphial Quests

description:
These quests can be played a limited number of times per day.
Play consistently to keep raising Heartphial levels!
title: Heartphial Quests

description: Battles can be skipped once they've been cleared. Only parties that have cleared the battle can be used to skip.
title: Heartphial Quests

description: If you collect all the Memsparks ("Story" or "Other") within a Labyrinth, a piece of a Puella Pictura will be filled in.
title: Puella Pictura Progress

description: Tap the picture frame to check which Window Into Memory contains its pieces.
title: Puella Pictura Progress

description:
This content is more difficult than standard mode.
Play in battler mode to gain the Memsparks you need to raise your Puella Pictura rank.
You'll earn a reward of Magica Stone x1,000 for completing a Puella Pictura.
title: Battler Mode

description: In battler mode, you can get Witch-themed 5★ Portraits. You can also raise your player level by clearing each battle to gain player EXP. Raising your player level also lets you boost the level cap of Kioku, so be sure to take on this challenge.
title: Battler Mode

description: The chat feature allows players to communicate with each other. Union chat, group chat, direct messages, and a blocklist are available for you to use.
title: Chat

description: Union chat allows you to chat with fellow members of the same union. You must belong to a union to use this feature.
title: Chat

description: Group chat allows you to chat with other players who've joined that group. You can create a new chat, or join up to 100 group chats you've been invited to. One group can have up to 15 players max.
title: Chat

description: Direct messages allow you to chat with any player. You can be a part of up to 100 different direct messages.
title: Chat

description: This feature lets you upgrade the Special Attack Lvl. of a Kioku. Increasing the Lvl. will make special attacks more powerful.
title: Special Attack Upgrade

description: You can raise the Special Attack Lvl. cap by ascending a Kioku to certain stages. The materials for upgrading special attacks can be obtained as rewards from events and at the Match Medal Trader.
title: Special Attack Upgrade

description: Unlocking magic lets you power up your Kioku. It can provide a significant boost to stats and skill effects, so be sure to unlock magic when you can.
title: Unlocking Magic

description: Special materials are required to unlock magic. You can get these materials from Magic Unlock Material Quests in the Upgrade Quests section, and as event rewards.
title: Unlocking Magic

description: You can set the battle to proceed on Auto mode. There's Semi Auto mode, in which actions other than special attacks are performed automatically, and there's Full Auto mode, in which all actions are performed automatically.
title: Setting Auto Modes for Battle

description:
The enemies who await you in chaos mode are even more powerful than those in nightmare mode.
Each quest in chaos mode includes Epic Missions, and playable quests may unlock after a set number of Epic Missions are cleared.
* Chaos mode quests will be added regularly.
title: Chaos Mode

description:
Epic Missions can be cleared by fulfilling certain conditions during a battle.
Each chaos mode quest includes three Epic Missions.
Once you clear a mission, you do not need to clear it again, so keep battling to clear all of the Epic Missions!
title: Epic Missions

description:
This is one of the ways you can train your Kioku.
Crystalis abilities can be obtained by clearing Crystalis quests.
Crystalis abilities can be further upgraded by rolling for boost effects.
title: About "Crystalis"

description:
When you clear Crystalis quests there is a chance you will gain Crystalis abilities.
The higher the difficulty, the greater the chance of obtaining Crystalis abilities of a higher rarity.
You can use QP to play battles, but skips are not available.
title: Crystalis Quests (1/2)

description:
Crystalis abilities come in EX, S, A, and B rarities.
An EX rarity is unique to its Kioku, and all Kioku have exactly one EX Crystalis ability.
title: Crystalis Quests (2/2)

description:
Only Kioku that take part in battle can gain Crystalis abilities.
Each Kioku will stock Crystalis abilities, so add Kioku you want to train to your party.
title: Obtaining Crystalis Abilities

description:
You can now set Crystalis abilities.
At first, a single ability can be set, but you can unlock more slots using special items.
Up to 3 abilities can be set to each Kioku.
title: About "Crystalis"

description:
Crystalis abilities are activated when set to a Kioku.
Their effects are only applied when the Kioku is assigned as a Main Kioku, not a support Kioku.
title: Crystalis Abilities

description:
Unlock items enable use of the 2nd and 3rd Crystalis ability slots.
Unlock items can be obtained from event quests, as well as Score Attack and Tower rewards.
title: Ability Slot Unlock Items

description:
Each Kioku can stock up to 100 Crystalis abilities.
When this limit is exceeded, older, lower rarity abilities will be converted into boost effect roll items.
title: Stock

description:
You can use roll items to add boost effects to a set Crystalis ability.
The number of effects varies according to the rarity of the ability, with EX/S granting 3, A granting 2, and B granting 1.
The same boost effect can have various effect values.
title: Boost Effects

description:
Boost effects are determined by chance when you use a roll item.
A single roll will grant a number of effects corresponding to the ability's rarity.
Roll items can be obtained from event quests and Score Attack rewards.
title: Boost Effect Roll Items

description:
These items allow you to lock current boost effects when rolling.
Lock items are consumed when performing a roll.
Lock items can be obtained from Score Attack and Tower rewards.
title: Lock Items

description:
Up to 10 players can take on a powerful enemy in this co-op battle feature.
Each season lasts a set period with different enemies featured each season.
LP is consumed when playing a battle.
In addition, you can trigger up to 6 battles per day.
title: Link Raid

description:
Link Raid battles have a time limit and a limited number of rounds.
Try to inflict damage efficiently within these limitations.
Enemy HP is shared across all participating players.
title: How to Battle

description:
You can send backup requests to other players before your battle and after your battle ends.
Up to 10 players including yourself can participate in a battle.
LP is consumed when joining a battle through a backup request.
title: Backup

description: Each season, bonus effects for certain elemental affinities and bonus effects for certain skills and actions are activated.
title: Season Bonus

description:
You can get the daily bonus by triggering and clearing a battle 3 times in one day.
The higher the difficulty of the cleared battles, the easier it is to obtain better items.
Plus, if you belong to a union, you'll get one additional reward.
title: Daily Bonus

description:
Link Raid has both play rewards and input rewards.
Play rewards can be obtained by clearing battles you have triggered.
Input rewards increase the higher your input rank upon clearing a battle.
However, you won't be able to receive input rewards if your input does not reach a certain amount.
title: Battle Clear Rewards

description:
You can earn Gold Link Medals and Silver Link Medals by clearing battles.
Medals earned can be exchanged for various rewards at the trader.
Trade limits at the trader are reset on the first day of each month (JST).
Medals will be carried over to the following season.
title: Trader

description:
You can get Magica Stones, Gold Link Medals, and Silver Link Medals by clearing the missions held each season.
Mission progress is reset the following season so you can clear these missions again.
title: Season Missions

description:
If your attack reduces an enemy's HP to 0, this will count as the last attack, and the minimum input of the cleared battle will be added to your input.
Even if you didn't achieve much input in battle, a last attack may help you qualify for input rewards.
title: Last Attack

description:
This is a feature where you can decorate the Home screen with Magical Girls and illustrations.
Mix and match the settings to your liking and create your very own personalized Home screen.
title: Dollhouse

description:
You can select the "Lighthouse," or select from four decoration modes: "3D Model," "2D Model," "Kioku," and "Portrait."
Try mixing and matching Magical Girls, illustrations, backgrounds, and music in each of these modes.
title: Modes

description:
The Magical Girls, illustrations, backgrounds, and music, etc., that you can set on the Home screen each come setting requirements (such as obtaining Kioku, Memsparks, and Dollhouse items).
See Help for details.
title: Setting Requirements

description:
With this feature, you can place a Magical Girl in real-world scenes or with a game background and take photos.
The photos can be saved to your device.
title: Camera

description:
Of the two shooting modes available, this mode is the easiest to use.
You can take photos by mixing and matching scenes or backgrounds with a Magical Girl.
title: Simple Shot Mode

description:
Of the two shooting modes available, this mode uses AR tech for taking photos.
Place a Magical Girl in real-world scenes and you can take photos that appear as if she's there before your eyes.
* Depending on the detected position, characters may not appear as intended.
title: AR Mode

description:
Depending on the mode and background, you can use different functions for shooting your photos (choosing a Magical Girl's pose, zooming in/out, adjusting the lighting, etc.).
See Help for details.
title: Taking Photos

description:
Exedra Crisis is a feature where you take on powerful enemies and earn a score based on the results.
You can earn total score and ranking rewards based on your score.
The feature is available for a limited time, with different enemies appearing each season. You can take part in battles up to three times each day.
title: Exedra Crisis

description:
Each season features buff effects that give your allies an edge in battle.
By meeting certain conditions and accumulating Vanguard Points, the battle enters the Vanguard Activation Phase, where these buff effects become even stronger.
title: Labyrinth Vanguard

description:
You can choose one effect to unleash during battle from three available options set for each season.
Choose the effect that best suits your party to gain an advantage in battle.
title: Name's Resolve

description:
You can assign up to 10 parties separate from your standard ones.
A Kioku that takes part in battle cannot be used again.
However, Portraits and Support Kioku can be used multiple times.
Set Name's Resolve to enable you to begin a run.
title: Party Assignment

description:
Your score increases when you win with fewer attempts, fewer actions, and at higher difficulties.
Aim to clear battles at higher difficulties as quickly as possible to improve your ranking.
title: Score

description: Rankings are determined based on your highest score in battle.
title: Rankings

description:
Rewards can be obtained by clearing battles, from rankings, and from your total score.
You can use medals that you have collected to trade for various rewards at the trader.
title: Rewards

description:
Friends are players that you follow, and players that follow you.
You can follow players from the Friends screen and Profile screen.
title: Friends

description:
On the Friends screen, you can manage your friends.
Recommended players are displayed on the Follow tab, so try following some other players.
title: Friends Screen

description:
Friend Medals can be obtained by sending "Likes" in Link Raid.
Friend Medals you obtain can be exchanged for items at the trader.
title: Friend Medals

description: On the Profile screen, you can set your name, a greeting, your favorite Kioku, and a title you earned.
title: Profile

description: Titles can be earned from specific missions, event rewards, etc.
title: Profile

description: Equipping a Support Kioku boosts stats and can activate support abilities.
title: Support Kioku

description: A Support Kioku's "Stats Applied" percentage can be increased by raising your Puella Pictura rank.
title: Support Kioku

description: Support Abilities have activation conditions, so check that the main Kioku meets those conditions when equipped. Additionally, their effects can be upgraded depending on Magic Lvl.
title: Support Kioku

description: This high-difficulty content unlocks original stories to read and offers 5★ portrait rewards. So power-up your party to play!
title: Nightmare Mode

description: For all Labyrinths playable in Standard mode, there is an additional Nightmare mode. Labyrinths to be added in future updates will also feature Standard and Nightmare modes.
title: Nightmare Mode Addition

description:
There are several types of points within a Labyrinth.
Battle Points: Only battles are encountered here.
Exploration Points: You'll take on a Kioku's form to explore within.
Flashback Points: You'll fully engage with a memory.
title: Labyrinth Map (Points)

description: You can check a list of Memsparks that can be obtained in the current Window Into Memory. Any Memsparks (Story) you obtain can be selected from the list to read immediately.
title: Labyrinth Map (Memsparks)

description: Collecting Memsparks fills in Puella Pictura pieces, which raises Puella Pictura rank.
title: Labyrinth Map (Memsparks)

description:
Upon completing a Puella Pictura, you'll get the following rewards.
- Magica Stone x1,000
- A fully ascended portrait
And in some cases, you can also get 5★ Kioku "[Lux☆Magica] Madoka Kaname."
title: Labyrinth Map (Memsparks)

description:
Each Kioku has a level, and their level cap is the same
as your player level. Player level is mainly increased
through playing various quests.
title: Kioku Level & Player Level

description: You can obtain Kioku EXP by battling or using exclusive items.
title: Kioku Level & Player Level

description: When obtaining a duplicate of a portrait you already have, that portrait will be automatically ascended. There are 5 stages of ascension, and ascending portraits increases portrait stats.
title: Portrait Ascension

description: A powerful boss awaits you at the end of your Labyrinth exploration. Auto mode cannot be used during Boss Point battles.
title: Boss Points

description: Once the final boss is defeated, the Labyrinth will be cleared and you'll get Magica Stone x300.
title: Boss Points

description: Area Boss Points will appear as you explore a Labyrinth. Enemies within Area Boss Points are more powerful than those you've faced.
title: Area Boss Points

description: When you clear a point, multiple points may be added to the map. These Extra Points are not directly related to the story's progress, but you can obtain items and Memsparks there.
title: Extra Points

description: If items remain within the point, the area around the point will sparkle. So use it as a visual guide when exploring a Labyrinth.
title: Extra Points

description: Each portrait has unique abilities. By equipping portraits that complement Kioku characteristics, you'll give your party an edge in battle.
title: Portrait Effects

description: You can clear Labyrinths by defeating bosses. Boss battles are more difficult than regular ones, so it's best to take them on after building up your Kioku.
title: Strategy Hints

description: From the menu, go to Party > Training > Kioku List and select a Kioku. Tap the + button on the details screen to open the Kioku Upgrade screen. You can get the materials you need for upgrades from Kioku Upgrade Quests in the Upgrade Quests section.
title: Strategy Hints

description:
If an enemy seems too tough, keep the following points in mind.
1) Use the break system to your advantage.
2) Try forming a party with roles in mind.
3) Use the unit details to check enemy info.
title: Strategy Hints

description: In general, all battles follow the same basic flow: put the enemy in break, raise the break bonus to multiply damage dealt, then unleash powerful special attacks to deal maximum damage.
title: Battle Systems

description: There are 6 unique roles in battle. Try to form parties that take advantage of each role's unique features.
title: Roles

description: You can check the enemy's skills and active effects during battle. Use this when you'd like to know more details.
title: Checking Enemy Info

description:
Battles in this feature have both a time limit and a round limit.
Multiple waves of enemies will appear, and victory is achieved by defeating the boss at the end.
Even if your party is defeated, battles can be replayed with enemy HP remaining unchanged.
title: How to Battle

description:
In non-boss waves, defeating an enemy will deplete the HP gauge displayed at the top of the screen by a set amount.
Enemies will continue to appear until that gauge reaches 0.
title: Enemy HP Link

description:
During battle, Vanguard Points accumulate as various conditions are met.
Conditions are also set for Name's Resolve.
Tap the icon to view details regarding that effect.
title: Labyrinth Vanguard (1)

description:
When you reach maximum Vanguard Points, the Vanguard Activation Phase begins.
Vanguard Activation Phase effects remain active until the Labyrinth Vanguard's turn.
title: Labyrinth Vanguard (2)

description:
The boss's HP is shared with other enemies on the field.
Boss HP will be depleted no matter which enemy you attack.
All enemies will be defeated once the boss's HP reaches 0.
title: Boss HP

description:
The boss will "awaken" and transform into a new form once its HP falls below a certain threshold.
The stats and the actions of the boss will also change upon transformation.
title: Witch Awakenings

description:
You can set 7 Loan Kioku in total; one for each role, plus one for the "All" slot.
You can also use Auto Set to assign Kioku to all slots automatically.
title: Loan Kioku

description:
You can rent Kioku from other players for certain content, such as the main quest.
Kioku you rent will be added to the 5th slot of your party.
Portraits and Support Kioku can also be assigned to Kioku you rent.
title: Kioku Rental

description:
In the main quest, you can also enable automatic Kioku rental.
This can be performed from Auto Rental Settings in the Party Menu.
These settings let you specify the criteria for which Kioku are prioritized when using Auto Rental.
title: Auto Rental Settings

description:
Friend Medals can be obtained by loaning your Kioku, or by renting Kioku from other players.
The amount of Friend Medals obtained is determined by the friend status between you and the other player.
title: Friend Medals

description:
Under Key Bindings, you can customize the keyboard controls for various actions.
Bind frequently used actions to easily accessible keys to improve your gameplay experience.
title: Key Bindings

description:
Exedra Quest is a new main story centered around the Nameless Girl and the Lighthouse.
Progress through the story to unlock Exedra Crisis.
title: Exedra Quest

description:
In Exedra Quest battles, Kioku and Magic levels are capped at specific levels.
The level caps vary by chapter.
This applies when a Kioku's level or Magic level exceeds the level cap in effect.
title: Level Lock

description: Depleting an enemy's break gauge will cause it to enter Break status. With enemies in break, it is easy to turn the battle to your advantage. Increase an enemy's break bonus to deal damage more efficiently.
title: Break

description:
Each Magical Girl has a role that represents her particular battle style.
Madoka Kaname is a Breaker, skilled at depleting the enemy's break gauge and generating break bonus.
Homura Akemi is an Attacker, skilled at dealing large amounts of DMG.
title: Roles

description: As a Buffer, Tsuruno Yui is adept at supporting allies and raising firepower with a variety of buff effects.
title: Buffers

description: As a Defender, Sana Futaba can boost endurance and is adept at protecting allies.
title: Defenders

description: As a Debuffer, Felicia Mitsuki is adept at turning the tides of battle by applying debuffs and ailments to enemies.
title: Debuffers

description: In general, all battles follow the same basic flow: put the enemy in break, raise the break bonus to multiply damage dealt, then unleash powerful special attacks to deal maximum damage.
title: Battle Systems

description: There are 6 unique roles in battle.
title: Roles

description: Has high firepower and specializes in dealing damage to enemies.
title: ATTACKER

description: Breakers excel at depleting the break gauge and increasing the break bonus.
title: BREAKER

description: Adept at supporting allies and raising firepower with a variety of buff effects.
title: BUFFER

description: Adept at turning the tides of battle by applying debuffs and ailments to enemies.
title: DEBUFFER

description: Adept at protecting allies, capable of shielding allies from attacks and boosting endurance.
title: DEFENDER

description: Adept at aiding allies with a variety of restoration skills.
title: HEALER

description: At exploration points, you will automatically explore inside the Witch's Labyrinth.
title: Exploration Points： Movement

description:
You may sometimes find items inside exploration points. You can pick them up automatically by moving your Magical Girl.
* If you Return or are unable to reach the goal point, these items will be lost.
title: Exploration Points: Items

description:
Memsparks can be found inside Exploration Points. You can pick them up automatically by moving your Magical Girl.
* If you return or are unable to reach the goal point, Memsparks will not be claimed.
title: Exploration Points： Memsparks

description: If you'd like to explore manually, you can take control of the Magical Girl at any time by tapping the "Manual" mode button.
title: Exploration Points: Manual Mode

description:
Inside exploration points, paths will sometimes diverge.
Tap the arrow or flick the screen in the direction you want to move.
Side paths may hide items as well as enemies.
title: Exploration Points ：Branching Paths

description: You may encounter enemies inside exploration points. Making contact with the enemy symbol will begin the battle.
title: Exploration Points: Battles

description: Memsparks (Other) may contain Portraits.
title: Exploration Points: Memsparks (Other) - Portraits

description: Memsparks (Other) may contain Music, as well as information on Witches, Minions, and Labyrinths.
title: Exploration Points: Memsparks (Other) - Music

description: In addition to items you can pick up along the way, you might also spot shiny objects on the ground while exploring. You can get an item by tapping them, so be sure to look around!
title: Hidden Items

description: While exploring, you may find dropped switches along the way. Obtaining a switch will add new points on the Labyrinth map.
title: Switches

description:
Bonus Points may sometimes appear as you explore a Labyrinth.
There are no encounters there, but you can obtain items and Memsparks.
So be sure to check each one you find!
title: Bonus Points

description: A party can consist of up to 5 Kioku. 1 Portrait per Kioku can also be equipped.
title: Assign

description:
Select the Kioku you'd like to assign.
You can change the slot to assign using the icons below.
title: Party: Kioku

description:
Select the Portrait you'd like to equip.
Portraits cannot be equipped without first assigning a Main Kioku.
You can switch equip slots using the Kioku icons at the bottom of the screen.
title: Party: Portraits

description: Let's try using Auto Party.
title: Party: Auto Party

description:
At the trader, you can trade points earned from Fate Weaves for Kioku, exchange event medals for various items, and more!
Some trade items are only available for a limited time, so be sure to check regularly.
title: Trader

description: A-Q Chips, upgrade materials, and other items will accumulate over time (24 hrs max). You will be able to generate and collect more rewards as your Player Lvl. increases.
title: Magia Box

description: Up to 7 times a day, you can use Magica Stones to collect 6 hours' worth of rewards at once. For the first collection each day, you do not need to spend Magica Stones.
title: Magia Box
